title: THaLLE-ThaiLLM: Domain-Specialized Small LLMs for Finance and Thai – Technical Report
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain benchmarks that measure faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on academic performance (O-NET), financial knowledge (Flare CFA, Thai Investment Consultant), safety (ThaiSafetyBench), and language consistency (IFEval-TH).
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion and therefore has no related findings.
